description: This file defines a Polymer component called IronSelection, which manages selection logic for a list of items, including methods for getting, setting, toggling, and clearing selections, with support for multiple selections.

classes.name: Polymer.IronSelection
classes.description: A constructor function for managing item selections with optional callback on select/deselect.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the currently selected item(s). If 'multi' is true, returns an array; otherwise, returns the single item or undefined.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all selections, except those explicitly excluded.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks whether a specific item is currently selected.

methods.name: setItemSelected
methods.description: Sets the selected state of a specific item and invokes the callback if provided.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects an item; toggles selection if 'multi' is true.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of an item.
